scripts.dev: sh -c 'export DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/learn_thai}; export TEST_DATABASE_URL=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-$DATABASE_URL}; export REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://127.0.0.1:56379}; export S3_ENDPOINT=${S3_ENDPOINT:-http://127.0.0.1:59000}; npm run dev:prepare && concurrently npm:dev:app npm:dev:worker'
scripts.dev:prepare: npm run dev:stack && npm run dev:db:wait && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev:worker: sh -c 'npm run worker:ensure-ffmpeg && npm run worker:ensure-whisper && tsx watch src/worker-node/index.ts'
scripts.dev:stack: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio minio-init
scripts.start:worker: sh -c 'npm run worker:ensure-ffmpeg && npm run worker:ensure-whisper && tsx src/worker-node/index.ts'
scripts.db:migrate:test: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; test -n "$TEST_DATABASE_URL" || { echo "TEST_DATABASE_URL is required"; exit 1; }; DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" drizzle-kit migrate --config=./infra/db/drizzle.config.ts'
